title: Decentraclasss
tagline: Decentraclasses is India's Learn-to-Earn ed-tech Platform with staking. Our main motto is to make education courses an asset and decentralise education so everyone can Learn-to-Earn and monetise the learnings by staking their own courses.
description:
Decentraclasses is an innovative ed-tech platform that works on the Learn-to-Earn model enhanced by Blockchain Technology and we will be a proudly and fully decentralised platform.

Our main goal is to transform educational courses into valuable assets and revolutionize the education sector through decentralization. With the help of our course-staking features, we hope to make education available to everyone by enabling them to earn money while they learn.

Our main focus is to remove the traditional barriers associated with education and empower learners to benefit from their knowledge by enrolling in courses.

We offer a wide range of both web2 and web3 educational courses to increase awareness and facilitate the transition to web3 technology.

The main problem that the project aims to solve is the lack of accessibility and monetization opportunities in traditional education systems. Many YouTubers specializing in blockchain development offer private courses on their websites, but these courses are not easily accessible to all students. Additionally, there is limited opportunity for instructors and learners to monetize their knowledge and skills. By decentralizing education and introducing staking features, Decentraclasses addresses these issues by making education more accessible, empowering instructors to earn additional income, and allowing learners to monetize

By developing Decentraclasses, an ed-tech platform that decentralises teaching and adds staking capabilities, the initiative seeks to solve the issue. There are a lot of YouTubers who provide blockchain-related videos and private courses on their platform, but Decentraclasses enables blockchain-focused YouTubers to launch their courses on our platform and reach more students, improving accessibility for students. The idea of tradable courses is unique because it allows both teachers and students to stake their own courses and make money while they are learning, generating incentives for both sides that last a lifetime.

how_its_made:
=> We use @reactjs for frontend development
=> @filecoin and @lighthouse is used to store and retrieve video content
=> @Push SDK to engage our students with real-time push notifications and chat applications so that instructors and students can easily share thoughts completely through PUSH
=> @Polybase - we have used polybase which is a decentralized layer 2 database solution and acts as a storage layer for web3 dapps.
=> @Huddle01 - We also provide mentorship feature on our platform for easy interaction between learner,mentors, Industry leaders powered by Huddle01.
